title: Taiwan Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Pressure
text:
Taiwan Stock Market Tipped To Open Under Pressure April 22, 2018, 08:34:  Taiwan stock market on Friday snapped the two-  gathered more than 160 points or 1.5 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now rests just beneath the 10,780-point plateau and it figures to take further damage   TSE finished sharply lower on Friday following heavy damage from the technology sector and more measured weakness from the financial sector. 
For the day, the index plummeted 191.84 points or 1.75 percent to finish at 10,779.38 after trading between 10,770.05 and 10,831.56 on turnover of 155.336 billion Taiwan dollars. 
Among the actives, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company plummeted 6.34 percent, while Catcher Technology plunged 6.33 percent, Innolux retreated 2.89 percent, Hon Hai Precision skidded 1.18 percent, Largan Precision tumbled 2.01 percent, United Microelectronics Corporation declined 1.58 percent, MediaTek dropped 1.66 percent, Cathay Financial shed 0.76 percent, Fubon Financial lost 0.40 percent, Mega Financial eased 0.19 percent, China Steel fell 0.21 percent and Taiwan Steel Union advanced 0.81 percent.
